newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jobless claims fell in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jobless claims fell in latest week.

text.p: of initial state jobless benefit claims, seasonally adjusted.
Week Ended Initial Claims 4-Week Avg. Continued Claims
R-Revised, Aug 17 Initial Claims from 327,000, Aug 24 4-Week Average from 323,250, Aug 17 from 314,000, Aug 17 Continued Claims from 2,525,000, and Aug 10 from 2,506,000.
Wall Street economists had forecast initial claims of 335,000 in the August 31 week.
The department said four states reported decreases in initial claims exceeding 1,000 on an unadjusted basis in the week ended August 24, the latest period for which the data are available.
They were California, with 1,627 fewer claims; Delaware, with 1,564; Michigan, with 1,350; and Ohio, with 1,006.
Delaware cited fewer layoffs in the automobile industy. The other states had no comment.

Tennessee, with 1,061 additional new filings, was the only state reporting an increase exceeding 1,000 in the August 24 week. The state reported layoffs in the food, textile, apparel, glass, and electronic equipment industries.
